tool.name: CreateGraph
tool.description: : Build a residue network graph from a correlation matrix.

param.name: input_matrix_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Path to input matrix NPZ (expects array key dccm).. Format: [input].

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Path to topology (e.g. PDB) for atom selection and distances.. Format: [input].

param.name: input_contact_matrix_path
param.label: input file
param.help: Optional NPZ contact matrix multiplied with the correlation matrix.. Format: [input].

param.name: outname_output_graph_path
param.label: output name
param.help: Path to output GraphML file. Format: [output].

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: corr_threshold
param.label: corr_threshold
param.help: Minimum absolute correlation for an edge.

param.name: prune_mode
param.label: prune_mode
param.help: How to combine distance pruning with correlations.

param.name: exclude_neighbors
param.label: exclude_neighbors
param.help: Zero matrix entries for nodes within this index distance.

param.name: restart
param.label: restart
param.help: Skip execution if output already exists.
